benchmarks.note: A real Formula 1 record for the operator's current measurement, not an Assetto Corsa GT3 target. Tyres, fuel, BoP, weather and car physics are not matched.

datasets.name: AssettoCorsaGym human and policy telemetry
datasets.attribution: Adrian Remonda et al., A Simulation Benchmark for Autonomous Racing with Large-Scale Human Data, NeurIPS 2024.
datasets.note: The human subset includes BMW Z4 GT3 at Red Bull Ring. It mixes driver skill levels and separate AI runs; it is not a world-record service. Only explicitly identified human data are bundled here.
